rca_of_issue: Fix that landed: server.py:693 _stripe_to_plain(obj) attempts (1) obj._to_dict_recursive() — the stripe>=7 SDK API, (2) obj.to_dict_recursive() / obj.to_dict() for older SDKs, (3) dict(obj) wrapped in json.dumps(default=str) as last resort. Previously json.dumps(stripe_obj, default=str) silently stringified the entire StripeObject because it is no longer a dict subclass, causing obj.get('metadata') → AttributeError('str' object has no attribute 'get'). The new helper returns a plain nested dict with metadata.user_id intact, so the webhook can correctly look up users and flip subscription_status / is_premium / current_period_end. Verified end-to-end via 5 webhook integration tests.
